title: decimal string key for array
summary: Legal decimal integer string keys can be converted to integer keys, leading plus signs or non-canonical leading zeros will change the result.
detail: The string key "8" and the integer key 8 share the slot, and the value assigned later overwrites the previous value; "08" and "+8" are each retained as a string key.
boundary: Decimal strings outside the native integer range are not treated as representable integer keys according to the same rules.
relevance: Explain why the map generated from the text is missing one item, or retains two seemingly identical numbers.
